      My point of view

      Not just one lane.

      My foundation is in Bioinformatics, where biology meets computation. I graduated from SASTRA Deemed University with a B.Tech in Bioinformatics, and I'm now beginning my professional journey as a Programmer Analyst Trainee at Cognizant.

      I'm building my skills in Python, SQL, SAP Plant Maintenance, databases and enterprise technology, while staying curious about software development, artificial intelligence, data analytics and computational biology.

      But there's another side to me: I love making things. From graphic design and poster composition to photo manipulation, video editing, typography and visual storytelling, I enjoy turning ideas and memories into something people can see and feel.

      I also like experimenting with AI-powered creative tools, exploring new technologies, learning by doing, and contributing to community activities. Whether I'm solving a technical problem or working on a creative edit, I enjoy the process of trying, improving and making the result more meaningful.
